# Existing geometry inputs

The two JSON files are byte-for-byte copies from `c7190e6`:

- goal-4/evidence/art27/legacy-painted-bounds.json
- goal-4/evidence/art29/legacy-item-bounds.json

They preserve the original painting geometry comparisons. They are test data,
not UI source snapshots, new budgets, or player saves. Current Playwright can
collect these tests without generating historical goal directories.
